<a name="controller-call"></a>
### `->call()`

```php
public function call($name, $input = null)
```

Calls a capability as the signed-in user (web pages): the same rules as REST and MCP

```
try { $book = $this->call('create_book'); redirect('/books/' . $book['id']); }
catch (ServiceError $e) { return view('Books/form', ['errors' => $e->fields]); }
```

**Parameters**

+ `$name` `string`: the capability
+ `$input` `array|null`, default `null`: the inputs (default: the request parameters and the route variables)

**Returns** `mixed`: plain data

+ **@throws** ServiceError

Source: [framework/core/Controller.php:186](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Controller.php#L186)
